previous_alert.note: The prior alert exists in the conversation record; no matching repository observation was found through the connected GitHub search, so this correction is preserved prospectively without fabricating a prior commit.

correction.reason: Fresh decomposition shows that the abnormal Avalanche DEX acceleration is overwhelmingly concentrated in Pharaoh Exchange and especially AVAX/stablecoin routing, while stablecoin growth and net inflows remain modest. This weakens the inference that broad discretionary speculative capital is migrating into the ecosystem.

pharaoh_exchange.note: Pharaoh is an incentive-engine AMM. Its Boost documentation explicitly describes LP/voter rewards intended to increase demand, TVL and volume across Avalanche. Current incentive spend is not accelerating nearly as fast as volume, so incentives alone do not prove wash trading; they do make the flow less clean as a discretionary-speculation signal.

asset.interpretation: Price persistence remains constructive and AVAX itself is not structurally rejected. The downgrade is about causal attribution of ecosystem flow, not token sellability or contract safety.

flow_quality_assessment.why: Roughly 84% of chain DEX volume is coming from one incentive-engine DEX with fewer than one thousand active addresses and more than forty transactions per active address per day. A single WAVAX/USDC pool dominates independent DEX tracking and turns over roughly 27x its displayed liquidity daily. That is compatible with professional routing/arbitrage and concentrated high-velocity flow, not the broad wallet migration required by the research framework.

cross_ecosystem_check.Robinhood Chain: Still the strongest raw speculative-velocity outlier: DEX +50.24% weekly and stablecoins +25.66%, but 24h net inflows remain negative at about -$22.4m, so flow quality remains mixed.
cross_ecosystem_check.Ethereum: No emerging speculative regime: DEX -11.71% weekly and stablecoins essentially flat despite +$46.9m 24h inflows.
cross_ecosystem_check.Solana: Stablecoins +4.75% weekly, but DEX volume -11.47% weekly; no clean fresh regime acceleration.
cross_ecosystem_check.BSC: DEX +32.17% weekly but stablecoins -0.63%; prior incentive/structural concerns still block a clean leader.
cross_ecosystem_check.Sui: DEX +18.17% and stablecoins +5.21% weekly, constructive but below threshold and without a newly cleared leader.
cross_ecosystem_check.NEAR: DEX +72.87% weekly but stablecoins -8.93% and the NEAR@3.33 milestone/airdrop program contaminates marginal usage.
cross_ecosystem_check.Hyperliquid: Stablecoins +3.62%, but spot DEX -24.67% and perps -18.51% weekly; no new acceleration signal.
cross_ecosystem_check.Arbitrum: Strong +$39.8m 24h inflow, but DEX -10.5% weekly; no native speculative-regime confirmation.

forward_tests: Require Avalanche DEX breadth to improve beyond Pharaoh: rising volume across multiple venues/pairs and a materially larger unique-trader cohort.
Require stablecoin growth and/or sustained bridge inflows to strengthen beyond the current approximately +0.6% weekly stablecoin growth and +$5m daily inflow.
Require AVAX price/volume persistence after the current high-velocity WAVAX/USDC burst cools.
Do not promote PHAR or another Avalanche ecosystem token without independent hard-gate clearance and wallet-independence evidence.
alert_reason: Material methodology correction: Avalanche's headline DEX acceleration survives numerically but no longer clears the framework's clean-flow attribution threshold once venue concentration, user concentration and incentive-supported routing are decomposed.
